test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
What would be the letter on the opposite side of 'S' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecc719676f014a351f29141f0302606cd638810d9dbf2eaca9b53513e5eecd85.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

\ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09a8aa8dd91b892528ceee6bc7a96220215071c75f2efd54dadde00d61619cbd.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

P → U

S → T

Q → R

Therefore, 'T' is the opposite of 'S'.

Hence, "T" is the correct answer.
